## History

Shirley was born in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia). As a young girl, she endured a tragic and neglected childhood, living with various families and spending time in an asylum before being taken in by [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). She eventually attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), where she competed in an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and successfully won the Avery scholarship. Upon her graduation, she returned home to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to reunite with her loved ones, unaware of the health and financial troubles looming over her household.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P1](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P3](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P4](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P6](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER V. ## Quotes

> "In the years to come thy memory will shine like a star over my lonely life, as that last story we read together says. Diana, wilt thou give me a lock of thy jet-black tresses in parting to treasure forevermore?"
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P10](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0010)

> "Fare thee well, my beloved friend. Henceforth we must be as strangers though living side by side. But my heart will ever be faithful to thee."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P12](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0012)

> "That is all there is left in life for me, now that my friend has been ruthlessly torn from me. In school I can look at her and muse over days departed."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017)

> "I’d be able to help you so much now and spare you in a hundred ways. I could find it in my heart to wish I had been, just for that."
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P40](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0040)

> "Oh, Diana, will you promise faithfully never to forget me, the friend of your youth, no matter what dearer friends may caress thee?"
>
> — Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P4](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0004)

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--shirley.md)

[Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) is Anne's bosom friend and schoolmate. Though forced to dramatically say goodbye after Diana's mother forbids their association, the two maintain a secret friendship. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later reunites with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) upon returning home to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after her time at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy).

- Friend of — bosom friends and schoolmates  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P32](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0032)</sub>

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--shirley.md)

[Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is Anne's academic rival at school, where they compete fiercely for top marks. Their competition continues through Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), where [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) ultimately wins the medal while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wins the Avery scholarship.

- Rival of — intense academic rivalry for top marks in school  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>
